scientific_integrity: An analytic proof is supplied and finite reproducibility tests are supplementary; historical priority and independent validation have not been certified.
scientific_limitations: Fixed complex dimension \(d\ge3\), fixed block split and cap threshold; finite homogeneous Fock sectors only. Remainder not known sharp. General gap large-deviation results may give implicit coverage.
title: Spectral determinant large deviations for coordinate-split caps in multivariate Fock spaces
